西风村漫天阴雾缓缓散去，压抑的寒气稍稍褪去。

那名东瀛阴阳师遁入后山密林之后，再也没有半点踪迹，只余下满地残留的阴煞气息，还有被雷光击碎的青铜铃铛碎片散落在祠堂石阶前。

七道被操控的村民亡魂失去铃音束缚，化作灰雾随风消散，没有戾气残留，也算挣脱了阵法禁锢，得以解脱轮回。

众人紧绷的神经稍稍放松，却没人敢掉以轻心。

“那阴阳师故意示弱逃走，不是真的怕了。”范梦雪收起雷木法尺，眉眼凝重望向前方破败古祠堂，“他是回去报信，把我们小队闯入西风村、破掉外围阴阵的消息，传回长白山腹地的三大邪派据点。”

王欣欣蹲下身，指尖捻起一块碎裂的青铜铃片，入手冰凉，还带着残留的阴邪咒力。“这铃铛浸染生魂血气，是阴阳师的本命法器之一，被雷法击碎，他已经受了不轻的内伤。短期内不敢再正面露头，只会躲在暗处布设更凶险的杀局。”

李二牛环顾死寂村落，打了个寒颤：“俺在东北活了大半辈子，从没见过这么邪门的阵法。整个村子被当成养魂炉，地底全是煞气暗流，再这样下去，附近村庄都会被连累。”

胡九郎立于村道中央，目光锁定前方老旧祠堂。

祠堂青砖斑驳，木梁腐朽，屋顶瓦片残缺不全，墙角爬满发黑枯藤，门口两尊山神石像布满裂痕，双眼空洞，透着一股死寂荒凉。

整座祠堂盘踞全村气场正中，地气汇聚，阴煞沉淀，正是七星锁阴阵的主阵眼。

“外围七口枯棺只是副阵，真正的阵核，就在祠堂地下。”胡九郎缓缓开口，“东瀛阴阳师联合九菊一派，在地底开凿暗道，布下聚煞祭纹，把西风村当成养料池，源源不断向长白山主阵输送阴气与生魂精气。”

林佳翻开平板，虽然深入山村后信号全无，但煞气记录仪还在运转：“仪器显示，祠堂地下煞气浓度是地面的三倍不止，地底有暗流涌动，像是人工开凿的地宫通道。”

杨瑞打开随身木箱，取出几枚探测玉牌，随手抛向半空。玉牌悬浮流转，散出淡淡灵光，朝着祠堂门口缓缓飘落。“玉牌感应到地底有阵法纹路、蛊虫气息，还有人为开凿的通道痕迹，往下至少三丈深。”

“那就下去。”胡九郎迈步朝祠堂走去，“先破主阵眼，切断阴气输送，再顺着地底暗流追查，看看能不能摸到东瀛邪派的地下联络线路。”

众人立刻整队跟上，依旧保持攻守阵型，谨慎靠近祠堂大门。

祠堂木门早已腐朽不堪，轻轻一碰便吱呀作响，一股浓重的霉味、阴腥味混杂在一起扑面而来。

踏入祠堂内部，光线骤然昏暗。

堂内神像早已残缺倒塌，香案腐朽碎裂，地上落满灰尘蛛网，四面墙壁刻满模糊扭曲的纹路，不是华夏山神图腾，全是东瀛阴阳道的诡异咒纹。

Chapter 79: The ancestral hall is broken, and the underground undercurrent - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The fog in the sky in Xifeng Village slowly dissipated, and the oppressive cold air faded slightly.

After the Japanese Onmyoji escaped into the dense forest at the back of the mountain, there was no trace left. Only the lingering Yin evil aura was left on the ground, and fragments of bronze bells shattered by lightning were scattered in front of the stone steps of the ancestral hall.

The seven controlled dead souls of the villagers lost the restraints of the bells and turned into gray mist and dissipated in the wind. No anger remained. They broke free from the confinement of the formation and were freed from reincarnation.

Everyone's tense nerves relaxed slightly, but no one dared to take it lightly.

"The Onmyoji deliberately showed weakness and ran away. He was not really afraid." Fan Mengxue put away the Thunder Wood Ruler and looked ahead at the dilapidated ancient ancestral hall with solemn eyebrows. "He went back to report the news that our team broke into Xifeng Village and destroyed the outer Yin formation, and sent it back to the three evil sect strongholds in the hinterland of Changbai Mountain."

Wang Xinxin squatted down and picked up a broken bronze bell piece with her fingertips. It was cold in her hands and still contained the residual evil spell."This bell is impregnated with soul-making blood and is one of Onmyoji's natal magic weapons. It was shattered by the thunder method and he has suffered serious internal injuries. He will not dare to show his face in the short term. He will only hide in the dark and lay out more dangerous killings."

Li Erniu looked around the dead village and shuddered: "I have lived in the Northeast for most of my life, and I have never seen such an evil formation. The entire village is used as a soul-nurturing furnace, and the underground is full of evil undercurrents. If this continues, nearby villages will be implicated."

Hu Jiulang stood in the middle of the village road, his eyes fixed on the old ancestral hall in front of him.

The green bricks of the ancestral hall are mottled, the wooden beams are rotten, the roof tiles are incomplete, the corners are covered with black and dead vines, and the two stone statues of mountain gods at the door are full of cracks, their eyes are hollow, and there is a sense of death and desolation.

The entire ancestral hall occupies the center of the village's aura, where earth energy gathers and Yin evil settles. It is the main eye of the Seven-Star Yin Locking Formation.

"The seven withered coffins on the periphery are just the auxiliary formation. The real core of the formation is under the ancestral hall." Hu Jiulang said slowly, "The Japanese Onmyoji and Jiuju's faction dug secret passages underground and laid out evil-gathering ritual patterns. They used Xifeng Village as a nutrient pool to continuously deliver yin energy and soul-producing essence to the main formation of Changbai Mountain."

Lin Jia opened the tablet. Although there was no signal after going deep into the mountain village, the evil spirit recorder was still running: "The instrument showed that the concentration of evil energy underground in the ancestral hall was more than three times that of the ground. There were undercurrents underground, like a man-made underground palace passage."

Yang Rui opened the wooden box he carried with him, took out a few detection jade tokens, and threw them into the air.The jade tablet floated and circulated, emitting a faint spiritual light, slowly falling towards the entrance of the ancestral hall."The Jade Tablet sensed formation patterns, the breath of poisonous insects, and traces of man-made passages in the ground, at least three feet deep."

"Then go down." Hu Jiulang walked toward the ancestral hall. "First break the main formation eye and cut off the transportation of Yin Qi. Then follow the underground undercurrent to see if you can touch the underground communication line of the Japanese evil sect."

Everyone immediately formed a team to follow, still maintaining the offensive and defensive formation, and cautiously approached the gate of the ancestral hall.

The wooden door of the ancestral hall had long been decayed and creaked at the slightest touch, and a strong musty and fishy smell mixed together hit the face.

Stepping inside the ancestral hall, the light suddenly dimmed.

The statues in the hall have long since been mutilated and collapsed, the incense table is rotten and broken, the ground is covered with dust and cobwebs, and the four walls are covered with vague and twisted patterns. They are not totems of Chinese mountain gods, but weird curse patterns of the Yin and Yang Tao of Japan.
